- `specialty_cost_share_assistance`: starting cost share and split proration, maximizer non-enrollee charge (with assistance still applicable), NSP-only and consent-on-file gate, rounding and deductible_portion, accumulator adjustment -> member_cost_share_and_assistance_0beba09b provisions 1–5. Tier figures -> assistance_coordination_tier_sheet_0d9e5778 (match variants: ECA/CM variable copay floor 25.00; Total Care maximizer, 30%, 30 days; nearest-cent rounding).
- `specialty_evt_assistance`: pharmacy enrollment after consent, once-per-program-year load, consent before load, once per shipped fill, foundations -> manufacturer_assistance_loading_e4334e5d provisions 1–5 + once-only table; tier switches -> manufacturer_program_enrollment_terms_9b824837 (12-month consent on every tier, foundation referral tiers match).
- `specialty_agg_therapy_coordination` -> several_therapies_coordination_c680d036 (all four clauses).
- `specialty_evt_payment` -> payment_posting_364d7ff3 (oldest-first, instruments, automatic assistance posting, ceiling).

No untriggered branch, tier or retired clause of these policies lacks a home.

## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the documents above was traced to the source:
- Additions that are definitional restatements of compute bindings only (no new obligation): "The member's own payments on the fill are the member payments posted on the enrollment's ledger that name that fill" (card basis; = `mem_on_fill`); "Card payments are the copay card assistance applications …, each dated by its entry date" (= `event_type=specialty_assistance_applied`, `date_field=entry_date`); "Each copay card payment counts once, although the history also shows it as a matching manufacturer-program payment" (= `card_f` reads assistance_applied only); "Intermediate figures are carried unrounded" (= single final rounding).
- No added confirmation, review, notification, wait or procedure; no "confirm the amount with the member" clause anywhere in the specialty corpus.
- Prerequisite-side checks: (a) cross-problem operational guidance — none; the only tool names are each extended policy's own tool in its own invocation block (`apply_card_assistance_5ca6ac5a` once in copay_card_payments, `pay_fill_balance_998729ec` once in member_fill_payments); `resolved_by` / `condition` text has no home. (b) A task's opening world state written as policy fact — none; all examples are labelled "assumed", and none reproduces this task's rows (the retail example uses 2026-03-12 / 2026-08-03 at $35.00, the task row is 2026-03-23 at $300.00).
- Retired surface: every retired clause is borne and labelled "no longer in force"; the KB retires nothing the source does not.
